title: Computational lithography: ILT mask correction over the process window
description: Partially coherent imaging (Abbe / Hopkins SOCS), threshold resist, inverse lithography through the exact model or a learned operator when its measured cost pays off, and the mask re-verified by the full Abbe model over focus and dose (pinneapple_physics.lithography.design).
